**A new desktop app.** cloak now ships as **Cloak**, a Fluent-design app for
creating, unlocking and locking drives, with a new icon. Unlocking mounts the
drive and opens it in Explorer or Finder; locking unmounts it. Drives lock
automatically when the computer sleeps (you can turn that off in Settings)
and always on shutdown and when you quit.

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Needs |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (x64) | `cloak-v0.2.0-windows-x64.zip` | [WinFsp](https://winfsp.dev) (`winget install WinFsp.WinFsp`) |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `cloak-v0.2.0-macos-arm64.zip` | [macFUSE](https://macfuse.github.io) |

**Windows:** unzip and run `Cloak\Cloak.exe`. Keep the folder together: the
engine (`cloak.exe`, `cloak-winmount.exe`) is in `Cloak\bin`.

**macOS:** unzip and drag `Cloak.app` to Applications. It isn't notarized,
so clear the download quarantine before first opening it:
`xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Cloak.app`.

## What's new

- **The Cloak app** replaces the previous desktop app. Your drive list carries
  over (`~/.cloak/drives.json`). Use **Add existing** to add any drive that
  isn't in it.
- **Light and dark themes**, following the system or chosen in Settings.
- **The macOS download is Apple Silicon only** (M1 and later). Intel Macs are
  no longer built.
- Locking now gives a drive up to 10 seconds to finish saving before it is
  unmounted.

## Upgrade note

Drives from v0.1.2 open as they are. Every computer that shares a store
should run v0.1.2 or later (see the v0.1.2 notes).

## Known limitations

- **The macOS app has not yet been tested on a real Mac.** The engine is
  fully tested, but treat the Mac app as a preview and keep a backup of
  anything you put in a drive.
- The app isn't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn on first run
  (More info → Run anyway).
- The downloads are larger than before (about 50 MB), since the app
  includes its own copy of Qt.
- FUSE-T is not supported yet (macFUSE only).
- The middle of every file stays plaintext on disk by design.
